resources.string: A 60-second profile check target for 15 minutes while the app is visible. Afterwards, background checks target a 15-minute interval.
Quick watch cannot remove an existing cooldown or connection hold. Check Request information.
What was read and compared, and when.
Checks made after this update will appear here. Earlier profile observations remain in the analysis screen.
The latest 120 records are encrypted on this device. Times refer to device reads and comparisons, not exact Instagram event times. Times missing from older records are shown as not recorded.
This difference was observed between the previous and new reads. The exact change time is unknown.
Could not open check history. Profile and list records are stored separately.
The last action could not be added to history; check profile and list records separately.

Profile counts are checked first. A count change prioritizes the relevant list; completed lists also retain a daily check. People can change even when counts stay the same. A background round uses up to six requests and a 90-second window for starting requests, at least 15 seconds apart. Android may delay work. Quick watch only runs while the app is visible and stops on the first error; 429 cooldowns are preserved.
Check and list-comparison history is also encrypted on this device. Up to 120 recent actions are retained; passwords and raw responses are not written to this history.
